issues.reason: Quantifiers, generics & scope mandates the distributing Implication rule for a non-modal verbal generic over a kind — 'Foxes rarely cross the causeway' is exactly this shape (generic kind subject, definite-witness object) — and a bare kind symbol in an Agent slot is licensed nowhere, the bare-class filler being reserved for non-specific OBJECTS.

This is an empirical kind-level generalization and the confidence dial reaches every kind-level claim whatever its head, so the generic route's (STV 0.9 0.9) applies, not the individual-fact default (STV 1.0 0.99).
